newsitem.title: FINLAND: SOM says Hambros to become FRA market maker.
newsitem.headline: SOM says Hambros to become FRA market maker.

text.p: Finnish options exchange Suomen Optiomeklarit (SOM) said in a statement on Monday British Hambros Bank, part of Hambros Plc, would become a market maker for forward rate agreement (FRA) instruments on the SOM.

Hambros Bank will become the third foreign bank authorised as a remote-access member in stock and/or interest rate instruments on the exchange, SOM said. In all, SOM has some two dozen market makers for stock and/or interest rate derivatives.
Hambros will be a member trading on SOM only on behalf of itself, a SOM official said by telephone.
"Hambros Bank is planning to start its operations on SOM with the FRA interest rate futures in September," SOM said in the statement.
